translations.rendering: The unwrought material, when divided and distributed, forms vessels.
When the uncarved block shatters it becomes vessels. The sage makes use of these and becomes the lord over the officials.
The world is formed from the void, like utensils from a block of wood. The Master knows the utensils, yet keeps to the block: thus she can use all things.

houseTranslation.text: Pu is not raw material waiting to be improved by carving, but the fact that carving is a real cost as well as a real gain — something is made into one particular useful thing, and thereby stops being everything else it could have been.
